candidates.title: Tesla adds 9 Cybercabs in Texas; purpose-built fleet hits 58 on TxDMV roster
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Hard VIN count: 9 new Tesla Robotaxi, LLC Cybercab registrations on Sept 18 lift the Texas purpose-built roster from 49 to 58 (448 combined with 390 Model Y robotaxis). Registration is not active-ride proof, but it is the first public step-up since mid-forties after Austin public Cybercab opened.

candidates.title: Tesla trains Austin first responders on Cybercab crash, fire, and door-open procedures
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official Robotaxi video says first-responder feedback is being designed into Cybercab as Austin Metro Police get briefed on handle-free butterfly doors, extrication, and EV fire response for unsupervised two-seaters still under NHTSA AQ26002.

candidates.title: Optimus factory steel frame nears north perimeter at Giga Texas
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Joe Tegtmeyer drone on Sept 17: steel ~5 column grids from the north beam, concrete on three upper floors, ~6 months after late-March groundbreaking. Tesla still points high-volume Texas output to summer 2027; Fremont Gen 3 pilot is the near-term data line.

candidates.title: Tesla app 4.61.0 treats Optimus as a home Energy site with dedicated charger IDs
candidates.whyItMightMatter: iOS 4.61.0 strings (passkeys plus Tesla Electric/VPP) label Optimus as a home Energy site with charger IDs. Dormant hooks, not a product launch, but the first consumer-app plumbing tying the robot to Powerwall/energy rather than factory-only use.

candidates.title: FSD v14.3.10 (2026.27.10) starts HW4 train with Collision Evasion notes intact
candidates.whyItMightMatter: New 2026.27.10 build keeps Automatic Collision Evasion, MLIR rewrite, and RL/vision-encoder notes from v14.3.9; Tesla's own notes still say 'v14.3.9 includes' under a v14.3.10 header. Early-install counts look like the start of a wider HW4 train, not a fleet flip.

candidates.title: Tesla Europe: 460,000 km of FSD Supervised testing in Spain, still no retail unlock
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Two years of DGT ES-AV Level 2 testing now has a mileage total from Tesla EMEA. Spain remains a proving ground, not a customer market; Tesla still points the wider EU file at an October 6 vote. No crash counts or Spain retail date in the post.

candidates.title: Tesla AUNZ: FSD Supervised logs 160 million km in first year with local safety scorecard
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official AU/NZ anniversary: ~160 million km of Supervised FSD vs ~2.4 billion km manual-with-Active-Safety baseline, claiming 40% fewer collisions and 66% fewer AEB events. First RHD markets; HW3 Lite for AU/NZ still unpublished. Tesla did not split AU vs NZ or subscription counts.

candidates.title: Tesla will operate public Megachargers at 3 Forum Mobility California Semi depots
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Forum Mobility breaks ground on four CA heavy-duty depots (+30 MW); Tesla will run public MCS Megacharging at FM Francis (Ontario), FM Adeline and FM Coliseum (Oakland). FM Santa Fe holds reservations for 330+ Semis. Partner-operated charging, not Tesla-owned real estate.

candidates.title: Top Gear Tech tours production Semi and $3.6B Nevada plant sized for 50,000 trucks/year
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First on-camera production Semi and Sparks factory tour: 1.7 million sq ft, $3.6B, 50k trucks/year (1,000/week at rate). Packs use 4680 cells (third pack for long-range). Claimed 1.7 kWh/mi, ~325/500 mile targets, 60% charge in 30 min. No U.S. retail price or current weekly rate on camera.

candidates.title: Tesla deploys first Accordion Supercharger: 16 factory-preassembled stalls per truck
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tesla Charging's first Accordion site ships 16 V4 stalls on one truck, 20% cheaper install, instant commission, between-space layout when curb-behind cabinets cannot trench. Stated goal: pre-assemble every Supercharger. Comes after 2024 charging-team layoff and ~17% YoY connector growth vs 35-45% in 2020-21.

candidates.title: Tesla reopens Roadster reservations at $50,000 refundable deposit ahead of Oct 1
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Live tesla.com/roadster/reserve: $5,000 card today plus $45,000 wire in 10 days, labeled fully refundable. No retail price or delivery date. New money on the queue, not just last week's October 1 teaser; prior holds already slipped toward 2027-28 customer builds.

candidates.title: Tesla India: order a Model Y today for delivery before Diwali
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Official Tesla India post pitches festival-season fulfillment (Oct/early Nov) with EMI from ₹39,990 and ₹600,000 down. Near-term India delivery promise, not a list-price cut; tenure, rate, and trim for the EMI floor were not in the tweet.

candidates.title: Bloomberg: Tokyo Model Y can fall under $23,000 after Japan plus city EV subsidies
candidates.whyItMightMatter: ¥5.6 million Japan sticker can stack to ~¥3.6 million (~$22,889) in Tokyo with national CEV plus city ZEV grants and a weak yen, undercutting China (~$39k) and California. Shanghai-built Model Y was Japan's top imported car in H1. Eligibility still depends on residency/registration, not a Tesla MSRP cut.
